scripts.dev: npm run build -w zerostyled && npm run dev -w zerostyled-ui-docs
scripts.build: npm run build -w zerostyled && npm run build -w zerostyled-ui-docs
scripts.test: npm test -w zerostyled && npm test -w zerostyled-ui
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w zerostyled && npm run typecheck -w zerostyled-ui-docs
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm test && npm run typecheck && npm run build
scripts.release: npm run build -w zerostyled && changeset publish
